newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end higher on payment demands.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end higher on payment demands.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed sharply higher on Wednesday reflecting routine payment demands that tightened liquidity in the banking system, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate ended at 6.095 percent against Tuesday's 5.837 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 6.00-6.25 percent against 5.75-6.00.
Dealers said they expected the rates to hover above the six-percent level on Thursday.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 6.1500-6.1550 percent against 6.1450.
